title: Valuative factorization for the Picard pullback locus
statement: Let f : X ⟶ S be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation with geometrically integral fibres, and universally isomorphic structure-sheaf adjunction units. Let E be invertible on X. Let j : Z ⟶ S satisfy the universal factorization equivalence of lem-sc-picard-diagonal-locally-closed (no immersion or finiteness assumption on j). Then each sq : ValuativeCommSq j has a factorization l : Spec(sq.R) ⟶ Z with l ≫ j = sq.i₂.

proof.text: Base change f and E along a = sq.i₂, putting p = pullback.snd f a and L = tensorPullback(pullback.fst f a)(E). Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensor pullback with the existing pullback and transfers invertibility. Flatness, properness, local finite presentation and geometric integrality are inferred under base change. Apply pullback_of_geometrically over the residue field sq.R/maximalIdeal to obtain the integral closed fibre.

Set t = Spec(algebraMap sq.R sq.K) and g = t≫a. Apply hO to g. tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso identifies its unit composite with the canonical structure-sheaf map, which is therefore an isomorphism. Evaluate at top and use ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective to get IsIso (pullback.snd f g).appTop. pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso and Hom.comp_appTop transport this to IsIso (pullback.snd p t).appTop.

The square commutativity gives sq.i₁≫j = g. Evaluate hj g to obtain finite locally free N with tensor pullback isomorphic to the pullback of E. This latter module is invertible and the generic fibre is nonempty by geometric integrality. Apply lem-sc-field-pullback-rank-one-trivial to get N ≅ O_K, then map this isomorphism under tensor pullback and use the structure-module comparison to trivialize the pullback of E. The pasting isomorphism pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso and two nonempty_tensorPullbackComp comparisons transport this trivialization to the generic pullback of L.

Apply generic_fibre_triviality_over_valuation_ring to p and L with the integral closed fibre, canonical global-sections isomorphism and generic trivialization from the preceding steps. This gives L ≅ O. The unit module on Spec sq.R is finite locally free; tensor pullback of it is O. Composing these isomorphisms gives the right side of hj sq.i₂. Its reverse implication yields the lift and its commutativity.

lean.statement: theorem picard_valuative_factorization {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S), IsIso ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf))) (E : X.Modules) [E.IsInvertible] {Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ S) (hj : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S), (∃ (h : T ⟶ Z), h ≫ j = g) ↔ ∃ (N : T.Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree), Nonempty (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E) ≅ ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj N))) [GeometricallyIntegral f] (sq : ValuativeCommSq j) : ∃ l : Spec (CommRingCat.of sq.R) ⟶ Z, l ≫ j = sq.i₂
